name: nk-clean-list
description: Reconcile messy CSV or XLSX contact exports into a clean workbook, an offline HTML report, and a row-by-row JSON audit.

interface.longDescription: Reconcile messy CSV or XLSX contact exports into a clean workbook, an offline HTML report, and a row-by-row JSON audit. Use when someone needs duplicates merged conservatively and an account of what changed without losing source rows.
